deploymentEvidence.evidence: Sourcify v2 returns this exact chain/address with deployment transaction, block 7664672, compiled contract BiswapRouter02 and non-proxy resolution. BscScan indexed search result labels this address Biswap: Router. The full BiswapRouter02 body extracted from address-bound verified source is identical to pinned biswap-org/periphery Router02 source after CRLF normalization and trimming, independently supporting attribution. This admission targets the legacy V2-style router, not the current separate Smart Router.
limitations: Deployment identity is taken from source/verification services, not an independent live RPC bytecode or state check.
Official current smart-contracts documentation names Smart Router 0x0eB6949e725A295Ecb3BEacFc3766610BC970BEF instead; that address is not substituted or admitted here.

abiEvidence.sourceType: address-bound Sourcify v2 abi and verified flattened source
abiEvidence.normalizedRouterBodyHashRecipe: Normalize CRLF to LF, take text beginning at contract BiswapRouter02 through end of file, trim surrounding whitespace, and SHA-256 the UTF-8 bytes.
abiEvidence.evidence: The ABI below is copied from Sourcify v2 abi for chain 56 and this exact deployed address, not a generic fork ABI. Sourcify reports creationMatch=match and runtimeMatch=match (recorded verbatim; not asserted as metadata-exact match). The deployed Router02 contract body matches pinned official Router02 after newline normalization. The Router01 discovery lead was not used as the deployed interface. getAmountIn/getAmountOut have four uint256 inputs including swapFee; Ownable and swapFeeReward surfaces are retained in full inventory.

rejectedAbiArtifact.reason: Pinned official build artifact has an extra sqrt(uint256) function absent from this address-bound verified ABI; all overlapping entries agree, but this artifact is not used as the deployed ABI and sqrt is not invented in the inventory.

reviewSummary.selectedScope: Nine explicit swaps (six ordinary exact-input/exact-output and three fee-on-transfer exact-input variants) and five explicit add/remove-liquidity actions without permits.
reviewSummary.excludedScope: Ten read-only/pure getters and quotes, three signature/permit entry points and three administrative entry points. No multicall or opaque execute entry exists in this address-bound ABI.
sourceReviewNotes: Ordinary swaps call factory-derived Biswap pairs with explicit path/amount/minimum/recipient/deadline parameters, not caller-provided arbitrary executor targets or calldata.
All swap variants can call the owner-configurable swapFeeReward external contract per hop; admin mutation of that hook is excluded but its runtime risk remains in selected swap warnings.
No current reward-hook value, ownership, pool reserves, balances, allowances or execution success was attested.
Full ABI preserves constructor/event/receive entries for evidence but they create no function capabilities.

additionalSources.evidence: Current official page lists a different Smart Router address. Retained to distinguish the legacy V2-style deployment rather than misstate it as the current preferred router.
Indexed Dedaub address page identifies BiswapRouter02 on binance, deployment May 23 2021 at block 7664672; supplemental only, not the ABI source.
